title: Undercabinet LED Tape Lighting with 24V Driver and Aluminum Channel Diffuser

summary: This Old House demonstrates a practical under-cabinet lighting upgrade using flexible LED tape fed by a 24-volt system. The hosts explain using pre-cut LED tape with integrated connectors for a plug-and-play setup, powered by a 120V-to-24V transformer, and routed to a basement access point. An aluminum channel is mounted under the cabinets to keep the strip straight and to host a diffuser lens for even light. When a length is short, they add a 12-inch segment and snap in the diffuser. The result is a warm, bright countertop area suitable for kitchen tasks, with a sleek, concealed finish.
